claim_zh_cn: 瑰夏（Gesha）基因决定了其高挥发性单萜烯（如芳樟醇）的高表达上限，浅烘焙下呈现高锐白花与单醇果酸。
claim_en: The Gesha genotype sets a high ceiling for volatile monoterpenes such as linalool; at light roast it reads as sharp white florals and clean, single-note fruit acidity.
